nodes.label: DebugLogger (serialized file logging)
nodes.rationale: Best-effort write chain that never masks the operation being logged; rotates at 512KB; promotes context.code to a top-level field so entries filter by error code without parsing.

nodes.label: Log Sanitization / Secret Redaction
nodes.rationale: Tokens, passwords, device codes, authorization headers and file body/content keys are redacted before writing so bug-report logs can be shared safely.
